anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Nailed to the cross; made a show; triumphing.
Quoted: sacrifice and offering you did not want; a body you prepared; behold I have come… to do your will.

pass_a_gloss: For confessedly he transferred us of Egypt and of its rulers, whom he nailed to the cross, having made an example, triumphing in openness over them in it. Through this: Behold I have come — for it has been written in a heading of a book about me —, O God, to do your will, having said before: Sacrifice and offering you did not want, but a body you prepared for me; whole-burnt-offering and about sin you did not take pleasure in,
pass_b_english: For it is confessed that he transferred us from Egypt and from its rulers, whom he nailed to the cross, having made a show of them triumphing in openness over them in it. For this reason "Behold I have come — for it is written in the heading of a book about me —, O God, to do your will," having said beforehand: "Sacrifice and offering you did not want, but a body you prepared for me; burnt offering and offering for sin you did not take pleasure in,"
source_text: Ὁμολογουμένως γὰρ μετέστησεν ἡμᾶς Αἰγύπτου καὶ τῶν αὐτῆς ἀρχόντων, οὓς προσήλωσεν τῷ σταυρῷ παραδειγματίσας <ἐν παρρησίᾳ θριαμβεύσας> αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ. Διὰ τοῦτο "Ἰδοὺ ἥκω – γέγραπται γὰρ ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου περὶ ἐμοῦ –, ὁ θεός, τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημά σου, προειπών· θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας, σῶμα δέ μοι κατηρτίσω, ὁλοκαύτωμα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ εὐδόκησας",
